events.summary: Varnel slits the throat of his first consort in 4067 AR.
events.quote: He slit the throat of his first consort in 4067 AR .

events.summary: After Garth joins his house, Varnel takes a 3000 gold bribe from Zarel to bar Fentesk's door so the Grand Master can capture Garth.
events.quote: Varnel took a 3000 gold bribe from Zarel

events.summary: Zarel destroys the four Houses and casts a spell that ages Varnel until only skeletal remains are left.
events.quote: all that was left of him were his skeletal remains

relations.quote: He was killed by the Grand Master of Arena Zarel
